title: The Great February Recharge
skyStory: The moon reaches one hundred percent, perfectly full in Leo, and the snowbanks shine like a stage lit for a finale. This is the Full Moon Recharge. Every stone on Earth turns toward the light, but two in particular, a ruby and an onyx, hum with special attention. Mars and Saturn stand side by side, for once agreeing completely. Tonight belongs to them.

reading: Tonight, take off the onyx bracelet and set it on a windowsill where the full moon will find it. Next to it, if you can, place something red, to stand in for Nancy's ruby. The two stones will soak up the moonlight together, recharging from across the miles.

While they charge, think about everything you have given this month: your time, your ideas, your fire. Then think about what you have received. The [[Six of Pentacles]] wants the second list to be as long as the first. It will not be yet. But it is getting longer.
joel.mission: Set the onyx on a windowsill under tonight's full moon and leave it there until morning.
joel.omen: Moonlight falling across the floor in a long silver stripe. It means the recharge has begun.
joel.stoneWhy: the Full Moon Recharge needs onyx

reading: Slide the ruby off your right pinky tonight and set it in the moonlight, on a windowsill or a table. Beside it, if you have one nearby, place the onyx bracelet from your left wrist. Fire and earth, side by side, catching the same light.

The full moon in Leo is generous, and it will fill both stones right up. As they charge, let yourself feel the [[Six of Swords]] gliding forward. The crossing is still happening, but tonight the water is calm and silver. Joel is rowing too. You can feel the oars moving in rhythm.
nancy.mission: Set the ruby and onyx side by side under the full moon tonight and make one wish over them.
nancy.omen: A clear patch of sky right where the moon is. It means the universe made room for the recharge.
nancy.elementWhy: the ruby is the fire stone

together.text: At 9 pm, both stones go into the moonlight. Send each other a photo of your windowsill setup, then stay quiet for one minute while the stones charge. Fire Tiger and Wood Rat, cabin and shore, all under one very bright moon.

game.intro: The Great February Recharge! Ruby and onyx on the sill, side by side. The paparazzi are already outside.
game.headline: FULL MOON CAUGHT CHARGING ___ ON A WINDOWSILL, ONYX DENIES EVERYTHING
